query:
SELECT name                     AS "name!",
               substr(started_at, 1, 10) AS "day!: String",
               amount_cents             AS "amount_cents!: i64"
        FROM entries
        WHERE project_id = ?1
          AND amount_cents IS NOT NULL
          AND started_at >= ?2
          AND started_at <  ?3
        ORDER BY started_at, id
